description: True Dolby Atmos, DTS:X, and MultiBeam Surround Sound Immerse yourself in theatre-quality 3D sound. With four up-firing drivers in the main bar and two more in the detachable speakers, the JBL Bar 1300 delivers true Dolby Atmos and DTS:X together with MultiBeam for an enhanced 3D surround sound experience. * This JBL Bar 1300 Soundbar image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Real surround sound with detachable surround speakers Enjoy real surround sound without the hassle of extra wires and power connections. Just place the two detachable battery-powered surround speakers behind you and get swept away in amazing audio. * This JBL Bar 1300 Soundbar image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Built-In Wi-Fi with Airplay, Alexa Multi-Room Music and Chromecast built-in Get ready to explore. Access over 300 online music streaming services through Airplay, Alexa MRM and Chromecast built-in. Enjoy all of your favourite audio content, Internet radio, and podcasts in high definition. The Wi-Fi connection also allows automatic software updates, so you can always enjoy the latest features. * This JBL Bar 1300 Soundbar image is for illustration purpose
